prompt.formato: type(scope): imperative summary. Types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore, ci, build, perf, revert. Subject at most 72 characters, no trailing period. A breaking change uses a BREAKING CHANGE footer.
prompt.cuerpo: What changed, why, modules, requirement or fix ids, and the quality-pipeline run id plus SHA. Do not write a test result that was not executed.

reglas.regla: Reject subjects such as update, changes, fix stuff, or wip.
One logical change per commit. Plan the series before a multi-step change.
Reject a staged diff that contains secrets, build output, or unrelated files.
Do not commit to a protected branch. Do not push. Push stays at gate G5.
Do not install commitlint unless the user asks.
